title: Keep requested-resource emails off until their rollout is approved

source.ref: Owner engineering handoff: keep sending behavior gated; requested-resource follow-up to EMAIL-049, 2026-11-15.

detail: The blank LEAD_MAGNET_RESOURCE_EMAIL_ENABLED envFlag blocks resource-copy enqueue before delivery IO while preserving valid capture and inline access. The public resource page offers an email copy only when explicitly enabled. Already queued canonical EMAIL-049 resource keys are held at the shared outbox drain using its existing pending/future-run_after deferral shape, without invoking a handler, spending attempts, acknowledging delivery, canceling or deleting a job. Other email and push paths are unchanged. The actual claim RPC returns the complete row and does not spend attempts; successful pending deferral releases its processing status. A failed parking write surfaces and uses existing stale-claim recovery. Owner activation includes review of held jobs/link freshness; this does not authorize sending. The new actual-function probe failed main 48a6be48c because an unset flag still queued mail, then passed default-off enqueue, legacy queued-job hold and enabled replay. Existing requested-resource probe/test assertions are retained and explicitly opt into their allowed paths. Isolated PGlite executes unchanged repository claim/dedupe SQL and actual processQueue, verifying repeated holds preserve the last attempt, future rows are not reclaimed, unrelated email delivers and an explicitly enabled due replay completes once. This is not Supabase/Auth or production proof. No production queries, SQL changes, real provider calls, email sends, campaign/nurture activation or Claude-branch changes occurred. Root item-specifically authorized only the LIVE-1307 closed import-map extension to load the actual new policy and actual env helper; all original error-path assertions and unexpected-dependency rejection remain unchanged. No lazy-load workaround, threshold edit, protected LIVE-433 change or skipped test is used.
